turns.input: *He looks at Captain Doran Hale, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Nicco studied the man. Captain Doran Hale was a solid wall of a soldier, broad-shouldered and bald, his heavy armor scuffed from use rather than decoration. A long, pale scar ran from his temple down to his jaw, pulling one side of his mouth into a perpetual grimace that matched the severe look in his blue eyes. Hale returned the gaze with the disciplined stillness of a man used to sizing up threats, his hand resting idly near the pommel of his longsword as the ambient traffic of the square moved around them.

"I am Captain Doran Hale of the West District Guard," the officer said, his voice a low, steady rumble that carried authority without needing volume. "This tower has been quiet for a long time. Seeing activity here draws attention." He shifted his weight slightly, his armor clinking softly. "I need to know who I am dealing with. State your business."
